from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import cv2
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
import artifact_io

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
S=8
H,W=144,256
first=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))

def poly_mask(points,scale=1):
    im=Image.new('L',(W*scale,H*scale)); ImageDraw.Draw(im).polygon([(float(x)*scale,float(y)*scale) for x,y in points],fill=255)
    return np.array(im,dtype=float)/255

# Background recovery is confined to the tiny object and its contact shadow.
remove_pts=[(126.5,42),(151.7,38.2),(157.4,44),(158,51),(151,54),(140,57),(132,54.8),(126.5,49)]
mask=(poly_mask(remove_pts)*255).astype('uint8')
bg=cv2.inpaint(first,mask,4,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA).astype(float)
y,x=np.mgrid[:H,:W].astype(float)
xc,yc=173.177,45.643
ang=np.deg2rad(8.717)
u=(x-xc)*np.cos(ang)+(y-yc)*np.sin(ang)
v=-(x-xc)*np.sin(ang)+(y-yc)*np.cos(ang)
r=(u/37.31)**2+(v/18.906)**2
# Fit the subtle illumination of the undisturbed matte top surface.
known=(r<.92)&(mask==0)&(x>139)&(y<60)
X=(x-160)/40;Y=(y-44)/24
features=np.stack([np.ones_like(x),X,Y,X*Y,X*X,Y*Y],-1)
coef=np.linalg.lstsq(features[known], first[known].astype(float),rcond=None)[0]
field=np.clip(features@coef, 20,65)
# Fractional ellipse boundary, rendered at subpixel resolution.
ys,xs=np.mgrid[:H*S,:W*S].astype(float)
xs=(xs+.5)/S-.5;ys=(ys+.5)/S-.5
us=(xs-xc)*np.cos(ang)+(ys-yc)*np.sin(ang)
vs=-(xs-xc)*np.sin(ang)+(ys-yc)*np.cos(ang)
rs=(us/37.31)**2+(vs/18.906)**2
ell=cv2.resize((rs<1).astype(float),(W,H),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
recover=cv2.GaussianBlur(mask.astype(float)/255,(0,0),.6)
# Place the missing bit of the platform edge back, including the soft lens boundary.
coverage=cv2.GaussianBlur(ell,(0,0),.35)
blend=recover*coverage
bg=bg*(1-blend[...,None])+field*blend[...,None]
# Sidewall portion that had been darkened by the original domino's contact shadow.
side=(mask>0)&(r>1)&(x>135)&(y>48)
# retain original inpainted sidewall darkness and wood grain.
bg=np.clip(bg,0,255)
Image.fromarray(bg.astype('uint8')).save(ROOT/'.tmp/background.png')

# Orthographic table-plane projection. Its ellipse matches the platform's view.
P=np.array([[np.cos(ang),-.507*np.sin(ang)], [np.sin(ang),.507*np.cos(ang)]])
u0=np.array([23.,-3.8]);v0=np.array([4.5,6.3])
world_u=np.linalg.solve(P,u0);world_v=np.linalg.solve(P,v0)
center=np.array([141.85,44.75]); thick=2.8

def geometry(theta):
    c,s=np.cos(theta),np.sin(theta)
    R=np.array([[c,-s],[s,c]])
    u=P@R@world_u;v=P@R@world_v
    pts=np.array([center-u/2-v/2,center+u/2-v/2,center+u/2+v/2,center-u/2+v/2])
    return pts

def render(theta):
    pts=geometry(theta)
    # Local shadow cast onto the stationary tabletop/platform.
    lower=pts+[0,thick]
    shadow_pts=lower+[1.5,1.5]
    sh=poly_mask(shadow_pts,S)
    sh=cv2.GaussianBlur(sh,(0,0),1.0*S)
    sh=cv2.resize(sh,(W,H),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)*.50
    contact=poly_mask(lower+[.3,.6],S)
    contact=cv2.GaussianBlur(contact,(0,0),.35*S)
    contact=cv2.resize(contact,(W,H),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)*.34
    base=bg*(1-sh[...,None])*(1-contact[...,None])
    # Project the extruded plastic block. Faces are lit by a fixed broad light.
    layer=Image.new('RGB',(W*S,H*S)); alpha=Image.new('L',(W*S,H*S))
    dr=ImageDraw.Draw(layer); da=ImageDraw.Draw(alpha)
    def face(poly,color):
        coords=[(float(p[0])*S,float(p[1])*S) for p in poly]
        dr.polygon(coords,fill=tuple(np.uint8(np.clip(color,0,255)))); da.polygon(coords,fill=255)
    for k in range(4):
        j=(k+1)%4
        edge=pts[j]-pts[k];norm=np.array([edge[1],-edge[0]])
        # Only frontward vertical surfaces are visible.
        if norm[1]>0:
            normal=norm/(np.linalg.norm(norm)+1e-6)
            sidebright=np.clip(155-43*normal[0]-24*normal[1],105,192)
            color=np.array([sidebright,sidebright+3,sidebright+47])
            face([pts[k],pts[j],lower[j],lower[k]],color)
    face(pts,(173,182,232))
    # Narrow molded edge catches the light without changing object dimensions.
    co=[tuple(p*S) for p in pts]
    dr.line([co[0],co[1]],fill=(181,190,238),width=2)
    dr.line([co[3],co[0]],fill=(188,193,242),width=2)
    # Realistic lens softness, premultiplied alpha to prevent black halos.
    a=np.array(alpha,dtype=float)/255
    rgb=np.array(layer,dtype=float)*a[...,None]
    a=cv2.GaussianBlur(a,(0,0),.36*S)
    rgb=cv2.GaussianBlur(rgb,(0,0),.36*S)
    a=cv2.resize(a,(W,H),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
    rgb=cv2.resize(rgb,(W,H),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
    return np.clip(base*(1-a[...,None])+rgb,0,255)

frames=[first]
for i in range(1,20):
    t=i/4
    # Smooth continuous clockwise rotation in real time, no camera motion.
    theta=np.deg2rad(56*(t-.16*(1-np.exp(-t/.16))))
    # Sub-frame averaging gives the modest blur of a real exposure.
    renderings=[render(theta+np.deg2rad(56)*dt) for dt in [-.013,0,.013]]
    frame=np.mean(renderings,axis=0)
    frames.append(np.uint8(np.rint(frame)))
frames=np.stack(frames)
artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)

"""Output-only helpers. No drawing or generation policy is implemented here."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))
